findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Quero entrar na água” with “Quero andar dentro da água” to retain the sense of wading.

findings.source_quote: “Melissa felt guilty for breaking the oar and Angie felt bad for suggesting that they splash in the water.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Angie ficou chateada” with “Angie se sentiu mal” to convey that Angie felt bad about suggesting it.
findings.translation_quote: “Melissa sentiu-se culpada por ter quebrado o remo, e Angie ficou chateada por ter sugerido que batessem na água.”
